title: The Flying Scroll
description: Zechariah receives a vision of a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide. The scroll is the curse that goes out over the whole land, striking thieves and those who swear falsely by God's name. The Lord of Hosts sends it into their houses to consume both timber and stones. [ref:Zechariah 5:1-4|Zechariah 5:1-4]
